en: Colorized vintage view of an industrial complex, identified as a cement factory, seen across open green fields. Several long, low factory buildings and tall chimneys dominate the skyline, one chimney emitting a long plume of dark smoke. On the right stands a large multi‑storey brick industrial building with multiple roof structures. Printed red text appears along the top edge in German.
